core_obligations: Reduce each of the three conditions to the base change along a surjective etale V -> Y using the four locality lemmas (proof lines 9695-9702).
Note that V is locally Noetherian when Y is, so that the third condition is meaningful on V (proof lines 9703-9704).
Apply the scheme case of the equivalence to the base changed morphism and conclude (proof lines 9704-9706).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a morphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces over S, finite local freeness is equivalent to being finite, flat and locally of finite presentation, and if Y is locally Noetherian these are also equivalent to f being finite and flat (source lines 9680-9693). The proof reduces all three conditions to the case of a surjective etale base change V -> Y, listing the four locality lemmas for integrality, finite local freeness, flatness and local finite presentation, notes that V is locally Noetherian when Y is, and then invokes the corresponding equivalence for morphisms of schemes.
